title: Immunoprecipitation of protein lysate from culture cells using Src antibody
protocol: Harvest NSC34 or C2C12 cells up to 80-100% in a 6 well plate.
Aspirate media and wash plate with PBS.
Aspirate PBS and add 500 μl of CelLytic™ M.
Scrape cells with a cell scraper and collect the media in a 1.5 ml tissue grinder.
Preserve 10% of collected media at 4℃.
Vortex Dynabeads™ magnetic beads in the vial for 30 seconds.
Transfer 50 μl of Dynabeads™ magnetic beads to a 1.5ml tube.
Place the tube on the magnet to separate the beads from the solution, and remove the supernatant.
Remove the tube from the magnet.
Add 10 μg of antibody diluted in 200 μL of Ab Binding and Washing Buffer to the magnetic beads.
Incubate with rotation for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Place the tube on the magnet and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the magnetic bead and antibody complex in 200 μL of PBS-T.
Wash by gentle tapping.
Place the tube on the magnet and remove the supernatant.
Add the cell lysate to the tube and gently tap to resuspend the magnetic bead-Ab complex.
Incubate with rotation for 60 minutes at room temperature.
Place the tube on the magnet.
Wash the magnetic bead-Ab-Ag complex 3 times using 200 μL of Washing Buffer for each wash. Separate on the magnet between each wash, remove supernatant, and resuspend by gentle tapping.
Resuspend the magnetic bead-Ab-Ag complex in 100 μL Washing Buffer and transfer the bead suspension to a clean tube.
Place the tube containing the magnetic bead-Ab-Ag complex on the magnet and remove the supernatant.
Add 30 µL of Elution Buffer.
Add 10 µL of Sample Buffer Solution (2ME+)(x4).
Gently tap the tube.
Heat for 10 min at 70°C.
Place the tube on the magnet.
Load the sample onto a gel.
